section_header: STEERING — Steering Column Assembly with Tilt Steering
title: STEERING — Steering Column Assembly with Tilt Steering

content.description: Illustration showing removal of main shaft from upper bracket using soft jaw vise and snap ring pliers

content.text: 5. REMOVE MAIN SHAFT FROM UPPER BRACKET

items: (a) Using a soft jaw vise and snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.
(b) Pull out the main shaft from the bracket.

content.description: Illustration showing disassembly of tilt steering support and column bracket, depicting removal of nuts, bolt and retainer

content.text: 6. DISASSEMBLE TILT STEERING SUPPORT AND COLUMN BRACKET

items: (a) Remove the two nuts, bolt and retainer.
(b) Take out the collar and release pin.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of tension spring and tilt pawl from steering column assembly

content.text: (c) Remove the tension spring and take out the tilt pawl.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of guide pin bolt, support bolt and shim from column bracket

content.text: (d) Remove the guide pin bolt, support bolt and shim.

content.description: Illustration showing use of hammer to remove serration bolt and tilt lever from column assembly

content.text: (e) Using a hammer, remove the serration bolt and tilt lever.
